text:
Josh Brecheen highlights legislative work and announces town halls for eastern Oklahoma
H. M. Craig
Congressman Josh Brecheen, who represents Oklahoma’s 2nd district in the U.S. Congress, posted a series of updates on his official Twitter account highlighting recent legislative efforts and upcoming events.
On August 17, 2026, Brecheen acknowledged a legislative achievement involving fellow representatives: "This is huge! Rep. Clyde led the charge to secure this win last year as the four of us (@RepChipRoy, @Rep_Clyde, @RepRalphNorman, and I) worked over a single weekend to ensure we strengthened the One Big Beautiful Bill before it passed out of Budget Committee and thereby achieved".
Later that day, he announced an outreach initiative: “Come, let us reason together.” Our office is hosting 15 town halls across eastern Oklahoma between August 26-28, 2026. We look forward to seeing you there!
On August 19, 2026, Brecheen shared another post linking to additional information: https://t.co/0S1wR1CNBl.
Josh Brecheen has served in Congress since 2023 after succeeding Markwayne Mullin. He previously represented his community in the Oklahoma Senate from 2010 to 2018. Born in Ada in 1979 and currently residing in Coalgate, Brecheen graduated from Southeastern Oklahoma State University with a Bachelor of Science degree in 1997.
